name: python-fire
description: Google Python Fire — auto-generate CLIs from any Python object with --help, tab completion, and REPL mode

install_steps: Use: python -m fire <module> to auto-generate a CLI from any Python module
install_guidance.note: Available via pip/pipx. 28k+ stars. Turns any Python object into a CLI. After pip install, use 'python -m fire <module>' or the 'fire' command.

commands.description: Auto-generate a CLI from a Python module or object and execute a command against it

args.name: module
args.description: Python module/object to turn into CLI (e.g., 'os', 'json', or a file path like myscript.py)

args.name: command
args.description: Command to run on the module (e.g., 'listdir' for os module)

args.name: args
args.description: Positional arguments passed to the command

commands.description: Passthrough to python -m fire for custom module invocation
